title: IBM logos / 8-Bar

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; interactive elements retain their captured state

slide_intent: Protect a familiar signature while adjusting its reproduction optically, because recognition depends on both consistency and legibility.
strategic_value: The distinct positive and reversed drawings, disciplined color and clear-space examples can preserve IBM’s accumulated identity across applications.
demonstration: The page compares positive and reversed 8-bar drawings, shows trademark placement and color pairs, explains clear space and alignment, contrasts photographic uses, and catalogs misuse and historical marks.
practical_value: Select the correct supplied logo version, then test contrast, isolation and alignment for its intended placement.

content_islands.name: Origin and optical versions
content_islands.spec: Place the title and resource links before the black positive and white reversed marks; follow with magnified counter-shape differences.

content_islands.name: Trademark and color
content_islands.spec: Show the legal-requirements example, core swatches and approved foreground/background pairs before rejected color treatments.

content_islands.name: Placement
content_islands.spec: Present the clear-space diagram, business-name alignment and scale relationships, then correct and incorrect photographic placements.

content_islands.name: Misuse
content_islands.spec: Arrange the prohibited altered marks as a red-marked example grid.

content_islands.name: Lineage and third parties
content_islands.spec: Close with the historical logo timeline and links for third-party and strategic-partner guidance.

ingredient.name: IBM 8-bar signature
ingredient.role: Identify and authenticate official IBM communication.
ingredient.application: Use the supplied positive or reversed drawing; preserve the minimum isolation distance equal to logo height in most situations; apply core blue/gray colors with at least five palette steps of contrast.
ingredient.scope: IBM’s 8-bar guidance as captured. The source qualifies clear-space adherence as applying in most situations and distinguishes US trademark requirements from other-country legal guidance.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explicitly links consistent visible use to memorability, authentication, authority and trust.
reference_purposes.Expression: Positive and reversed specimens reveal the optical adjustments and characteristic eight-bar form.
reference_purposes.Application: Clear-space, alignment and photograph examples teach placement decisions.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source restricts logo color to blue and gray families, requires at least five palette steps of foreground/background separation, and prohibits distortion, recoloring individual letters and gradients.
